items.raw_excerpt: 欧盟委员会4月15日发布公报称，已向美国元宇宙平台公司发出补充异议声明，初步认定该公司在调整了限制第三方人工智能（AI）助手接入其旗下即时通信应用程序WhatsApp的相关措施后，仍违反欧盟反垄断规则，拟要求该公司恢复第三方AI助手对WhatsApp的访问权限。（新华社）

title_i18n.en: The European Commission has preliminarily determined that Meta remains in violation of regulations even after adjusting its policies.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 欧盟委员会4月15日发布公报称，已向美国元宇宙平台公司发出补充异议声明，初步认定该公司在调整了限制第三方人工智能（AI）助手接入其旗下即时通信应用程序WhatsApp的相关措施后，仍违反欧盟反垄断规则，拟要求该公司恢复第三方AI助手对WhatsApp的访问权限。（新华社）
excerpt_i18n.en: On April 15, the European Commission issued a communiqué stating that it has sent a supplementary statement of objections to the American metaverse platform company, preliminarily determining that the company still violates EU antitrust rules after adjusting measures restricting third-party artificial intelligence (AI) assistants from accessing its instant messaging application WhatsApp. The Commission intends to require the company to restore third-party AI assistants' access to WhatsApp. (Xinhua News Agency)
excerpt_i18n.es: La Comisión Europea emitió un comunicado el 15 de abril, indicando que ha enviado una declaración de objeciones complementaria a la empresa estadounidense Meta Platforms. Se determinó preliminarmente que, incluso después de ajustar las medidas relacionadas con el acceso de asistentes de inteligencia artificial de terceros a su aplicación de mensajería instantánea WhatsApp, la compañía sigue violando las normas antimonopolio de la UE. Se planea exigir a la empresa que restaure el acceso de asistentes de IA de terceros a WhatsApp. (Xinhua)

excerpt_i18n.en: In early 2026, after NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang declared "Physical AI is the second inflection point" at CES, World Models became a key battleground for global tech giants. Even before this, many scholars in academia had recognized that AI must understand the common sense of the physical world to truly serve humanity. As influential figures like AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li and former Meta Chief AI Scientist, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun entered the field, it became increasingly clear that this was a more fundamental and challenging domain than large language models. When searching for scholars and companies in this field domestically, Chen Tianrun came into view. Born in 2000, this doctoral student founded Magic Core Technology in 2022. After validating the concept from scratch with a 3D printer, the company fully pivoted to spatial intelligence in 2024. Describing himself modestly as "someone who makes small appliances" or "an entrepreneur from the 3C products industry," this post-2000s founder is not only the CEO of a "multi-billion yuan valued" company in the World Model domain but also a protégé of Academician Pan Yunhe. Recently, Magic Core Technology secured hundreds of millions in funding from giants like Huawei and Lenovo, thanks to breakthroughs in spatial intelligence and World Models. Today, they position themselves as an infrastructure service provider for spatial intelligence. In this conversation, Chen Tianrun delves into technical topics related to spatial intelligence while sharing insights from an entrepreneur's perspective.

Sin embargo, mucho antes, muchos académicos ya habían reconocido que la IA debe comprender el sentido común del mundo físico para servir verdaderamente a la humanidad. Con figuras como Fei-Fei Li, la madrina de la IA, y Yann LeCun, ex científico jefe de IA de Meta y ganador del Premio Turing, adentrándose en este campo, se ha ido comprendiendo que se trata de una disciplina más fundamental y desafiante que los grandes modelos de lenguaje.
